title: Rock Hard and Unforgiving
text: Rock Hard and Unforgiving. Hands down the worst mattress I have ever purchased. This mattress is for 300+ lb people as it is hard as a rock and I am 6'1" 240 lbs. 6 months in amd I have never had body aches like I do now. I will gladly spend the money getting new mattresses as these are not suitable for most people. DO NOT BUY!

product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Limited Edition 11 Inch Firm Hybrid Mattress, CertiPUR-US Certified Gel Foam, Twin XL
features: LUXURY MATTRESS. Your ticket to luxurious comfort. For back sleepers, this mattress's foam layers are a perfect match for feeling well rested with its combination of wrapped coils and gel memory foam
11" PROFILE. Designed with layers of support foam, gel memory foam for pressure point relief and power packed wrapped coils to reduce motion transfer
ULTRA COMFORT: While the foam layers cradle your body in comfort, the 4-way stretch knit cover is a dream to lay on for kids and adults alike
TWIN XL SIZE: Measures 37" W x 79" D x 11" H and is compatible with most twin xl bed frames

READY FOR INSTANT ENJOYMENT: Arrives in a box. Simply unbox, cut the protective wrap, unroll and watch the mattress expand. Mattress is safe to sleep on immediately but can take 72+ hours for any risidual scent from packaging to dissipate and for mattress to completely expand based on ambient room temperature, humidity, air pressure & ventilation.
DIRECT FROM THE MANUFACTURER: Ashley Furniture goes the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries. The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses. For every taste and budget
